output.summary: The function processes an input buffer using a bitwise algorithm and returns a 64-bit value. It does not modify the input buffer and writes nothing to the output buffer.

claims.text: Uses a nested loop structure: an outer loop over the input buffer and an inner loop over 8 bits.
Returns a 64-bit value computed from the input buffer.
Uses the constant 0xffffffff in the initial value of h.
Uses the constant 0xf7179bf5 in the bitwise transformation.
